description: This PHP source file defines a function 'additionalDetailsProject' that generates an informational string for displaying project details, mainly focusing on the description field of a project template in SuiteCRM. It includes license headers, checks for valid entry point, and global language support.

methods.name: additionalDetailsProject
methods.description: Generates an array with HTML string and links for displaying project details, particularly the description, for a given project template record.
